content:
kai: Quick heads-up: saw a locale-specific regression after the q5-int4 packaging. Triggers only on mixed CJK + RTL punctuation sequences (IVS + mirrored brackets). BLEU on zh->ar devmix dropped ~2.1 vs float.

elena: short repro?

kai: minimal repro run on model nebula-q5-int4: 
```
$ printf '\u6f22\uE0100\u5b57\u0020\u060C' | ./tokenize --model models/nebula-q5-int4
# -> tokens: ["\u6f22","\uE0100","\u5b57","\u060C"]
# float tokenizer -> ["\u6f22\u5b57","\u060C"]
```
float detok: "\u6f22\u5b57\u060C"
q5-int4 detok: "\u6f22\uE0100 \u5b57\u060C"  # extra space after preserved VS -> punctuation alignment breaks

mike: so packaging made the VS its own token id and detok spacing rule inserted whitespace.

taro: any quick sample from eval set that broke meaning?

kai: yes - from multilingual devmix:
```
input: "\u8a66\u984c\uff1a(\u6f22\uE0100\u5b57)\u0627\u0644\u062a\u062c\u0631\u0628\u0629\u3002"
float decode: "\u8a66\u984c\uff1a(\u6f22\u5b57)\u0627\u0644\u062a\u062c\u0631\u0628\u0629\u3002"
q5-int4 decode:  "\u8a66\u984c\uff1a(\u6f22\uE0100 \u5b57)\u0627\u0644\u062a\u062c\u0631\u0628\u0629\u3002"
```
Observe the space before the Arabic segment which pushes punctuation alignment and hurts BLEU/exact-match.

amina: root cause candidates: (1) sentencepiece retrain vs copy during packaging, (2) remap/truncation that split multi-codepoint tokens, (3) detok heuristic treating VS/Cf as spacing anchors when standalone.

mike: CI guard would have caught this if we had IVS+mirrored-bracket cases in the packaging parity suite.

pack-bot: packaging job queued: nebula-q5-int4 -> canary-eu at 2026-03-22T21:30:00Z (rollout r-2026-03-22-128).

elena: short-term mitigation options: (A) edge normalizer to strip VS for zh/ja canary routes, (B) repack preserving float token table for multi-codepoint entries, (C) quick detok tweak to avoid inserting spaces for Cf tokens between CJK and RTL punctuation.

amina: detok tweak is fastest but might break emoji/ligature tasks that rely on ZWJ/VS as separate tokens. Prefer repack if feasible.

mike: i'll try a remap that reuses float index for existing combined tokens and rebuild int4; should be ~30-45m.

ci-bot: nightly regression alert: nebula-q5-int4 vs float: BLEU 31.2 -> 29.1 (-2.1), exact punctuation matches 94.2% -> 88.5%.

mike: remap done locally; quick smoke on IVS-mirror set shows parity with float. Uploading artifact to s3://redwood-staging/models/nebula-q5-int4-remap-20260322.tar.gz

elena: nice. i'll add 20 IVS + mirrored-bracket samples to the packaging parity suite and a packaging guard that diffs detok outputs before approving a build.

pack-bot: canary A/B scheduled: Canary A = current q5-int4, Canary B = remapped q5-int4 (no edge-normalize). Job id j-8001.

ci-bot: canary results (subset 2k): A BLEU=29.0, B BLEU=31.0, detok-exact B ~ matches float on IVS set.

amina: remap looks good. we'll adopt repack and merge packaging guard. I'll open PR for guard + test vectors.

mike: PR #4987 opened with remap script + artifact refs.

elena: filing issue ML-9001 with repro, artifacts, canary logs, and suggested onboarding checklist entries: "include IVS/mirror-bracket/ZWJ cases in packaging parity". cc @taro @amina

kai: thanks folks. once guard PR merges, we'll re-release q5-int4 and mark the issue closed after dedicated rollout. :white_check_mark:
